description: This PHP class provides utility functions for hashing and verifying passwords using PHP's built-in password_hash and password_verify functions, encapsulated within the PasswordHash class in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PasswordHash
classes.description: A utility class for creating and verifying password hashes using PHP's PASSWORD_BCRYPT algorithm with a predefined cost factor.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash of the given password using the specified cost parameter.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a given hash.
